adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff for apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts, line 32 shows `const reqBody = appCredentialWebhookRequestBodySchema.parse(req.body);` which throws on invalid input. Lines 55-57 show `const keys = JSON.parse(symmetricDecrypt(reqBody.keys, process.env.CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY || ""));` - both symmetricDecrypt and JSON.parse can throw exceptions on malformed ciphertext or invalid JSON. There's no try-catch wrapper around these operations, so they would result in uncaught exceptions returning 500 errors. This is a real bug - permanent input failures (malformed data) would cause 500s that webhook senders typically retry, when they should return 4xx to indicate the request itself is invalid.
